QuestInfo.name: Legendary Scissors
QuestInfo.1: When you open the Locker, you find the #bLegendary Scissors#k. Hurry and deliver the scissors to Marshall.
QuestInfo.2: #bMarshall#k was ecstatic when you delivered the Legendary Scissors and agreed to style Blake's hair in a heartbeat. Give #bLana#k the good news.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Exp 1,300\nCan proceed to the Hair Stylist, Booked! quest

0.0: The Legendary Scissors are inside the locker! Would you like to take the scissors out?

yes.0: #b(These scissors exude a mysterious force. Better deliver the scissors to Marshall.)#k

1.0: It cannot be! What is that you hold in your hands? Are...are those my Legendary Scissors?!

yes.0: Oh my precious... I weep with joy! *sniff sniff* Thank you. I could not do my job without these blessed scissors. #b#h0##k, I will joyfully take care of Blake's hair. Please let #bLana#k at Big Hit Records know. Oh, my darling scissors, never leave my side again.

npc.0: #b(The locker is empty. Take these #bLegendary Scissors#k over to #bMarshall#k.)#k

item.0: Only the #bLegendary Scissors#k can convince #bMarshall#k to help.

lost.0: #b(The Legendary Scissors are in the locker. How did they get back there? Hurry up and take the scissors.)#k
